categories.title: Start here
categories.tagline: Read the map, then use the controls.
categories.description: Quick Start explains the preset inside Lumiverse. It stays disabled because it is editor documentation, not model input.
categories.tip: Read the guide; leave structural blocks as supplied.

categories.title: The storytelling foundation
categories.description: Roleplay Rules protect your avatar. Character Fidelity, Subtext & Perception and Cause & Consequence ground the cast. Repetition Control and Continuous Scenes discourage replaying a point or posing every reply as a handoff.
categories.tip: Usually leave these enabled. Characters may act independently without inventing your response.

categories.title: Who plays, who knows, who resolves
categories.description: Session Mode chooses Roleplay or Chapter Writing. Group Chat coordinates real group chats. Black Veil limits disclosure; Action Checks handles explicit stakes or an external d6. Scene Transitions recognizes bounded Cut & Carry commands.
categories.tip: Use variables for modes. Scene Transitions is a disabled prompt-block opt-in; Chapter Writing overrides RP/group/check routing.

categories.title: Host Environment
categories.tagline: Where the model gets its facts.
categories.description: These blocks supply the scenario, card, persona, world info and chat history. The Environment also governs ongoing world activity through fictional time and available evidence. Extra source slots can duplicate material already loaded elsewhere.
categories.tip: Keep source/wrapper blocks intact. Background work needs causes and elapsed story time, never human typing time.

categories.title: Narrator Lens
categories.description: Choose The Observer, The Romantic, The Sensualist, The Transgressor, The Aggrieved Curator or The Serial Dramatist. Reality Anomalies limits new impossible facts. A lens changes emphasis, not canon or personality.
categories.tip: A romantic lens does not guarantee attraction, and complications must not erase earned success.

categories.title: Black Channel
categories.description: Black-Channel Access is the master content switch. Exposure Threshold chooses Surface Contact, Open Nerve or Red Depth; the other blocks provide more specific guidance.
categories.tip: Use the master variable, not section-wrapper removal. The official release starts at Surface Contact; the interview can turn Black Channel off.

categories.title: The prose desk
categories.description: Response Length chooses Targeted, Free-Flow or Pulse. Dialogue Balance is qualitative emphasis. Point of View selects the camera; Prose Style develops connected, character-shaped narration. Response Language covers commentary, planning, menus and Archive values too.
categories.tip: Anti-Slop Filter is on by default. Disable its prompt block to remove it; no separate Cliché Gate variable remains.

categories.title: People with lives of their own
categories.description: Character Depth, Natural Dialogue and Human Error add individual range. Belief & Evidence separates a finding from its explanation; Emotional Consistency preserves mixed motives. Independent Lives gives people duties beyond your arrival.
categories.tip: Optional anatomy and antagonist blocks suit particular casts. Consistency requires neither permanent hostility nor automatic cooperation.

categories.title: Your place in the story
categories.description: Pronouns & Gender can override the persona identity. Action Interruptions chooses whether timely interventions may prevent later intended acts. Favor Your Character and Attraction Bias are optional modifiers, both off in the official release.
categories.tip: Use persona defaults unless you want an override. Action Checks takes priority over ordinary resolution and favoritism rules.

categories.title: The Neural Dock and memory
categories.description: Fork Protocol offers choices; Conductance tracks the main character’s stance. Deep Archive holds enabled continuity trackers. EiDOS Core Trace and Kazz Parasite Feed are separate from the chosen cognition route.
categories.tip: Dramatic Irony and Strict Discovery suppress both commentaries. Archive children need their master; Sealed Pressure is a disabled block opt-in.

categories.title: Presentation
categories.description: The Presentation variable menu groups Voice Effects, Dialogue Cards, Scene Motifs & Thoughts and Chapter Headers. Speaker Colors, Digital Interfaces and Physical Documents retain their own rules. Motifs use a fixed library, not model-drawn SVGs.
categories.tip: Keep carriers on and change variables. Choose OG dark, OG light or LITE adaptive; never stack renderer families. Official Presentation switches start off.

categories.title: Cognition and final assembly
categories.tagline: One resolved response, in the right order.
categories.description: Cognition Settings selects Creative Pathfinding, EiDOS Reconstruction or Kazz Override. Trace Word Aim scales full Creative/Kazz records; Visible Trace Detail can select a compact card or omit it. The final Response Plan resolves required panels and their order.
categories.tip: Keep route carriers and assembly blocks enabled. Character Neurology is fixed; Agreement Bias Check is optional. Trace settings do not configure native provider reasoning.

modules.name: Session Mode
modules.description: Roleplay preserves your avatar; Chapter Writing authors the fictional cast one chapter at a time.

controls.name: session_mode
controls.label: Story Mode
controls.description: Roleplay: you own your avatar. Matrix: EiDOS authors the whole fictional cast, then offers six chapter directions. No automatic multi-chapter loop.

controls.name: matrix_words
controls.label: Chapter Word Aim
controls.description: Approximate chapter prose length in Matrix. Independent of RP Narrative Mass and trace budget; output limits still apply.

modules.name: Group Chat
modules.tagline: Give an ensemble room to breathe.
modules.description: Focused Character or Ensemble coordinates eligible members in a real group chat.

controls.name: group_mode
controls.label: Group Chat Mode
controls.description: Group mode: Inactive in solo chats and Matrix. Focus: one card owns the turn. Ensemble: the present eligible cast may interact.

modules.name: Black Veil
modules.description: Open permits backstage material. Dramatic Irony and Strict Discovery suppress commentary and visible traces; Strict also uses an external camera.

controls.name: veil_mode
controls.label: Spoiler Mode
controls.description: Open allows enabled EiDOS/Kazz commentary. Dramatic Irony and Strict suppress BOTH commentaries, visible cognition and private trackers even when their blocks are enabled; saved switches are preserved. Strict also overrides NPC interior POV.

controls.name: veil_allowance
controls.label: Allowed Revelations
controls.description: Optional scope for Dramatic irony, e.g. the guard is worried about a public inspection. Does not authorize invented secrets. Strict does not allow private/offscreen glimpses.

modules.name: Action Checks
modules.description: Choose No Checks, diceless stakes or externally rolled player d6 checks.

controls.name: rpg_mode
controls.label: Action Checks
controls.description: New uncertain actions become attempts. Player d6 needs real external dice and a matching check ID; Diceless makes no randomness claim.

modules.name: Scene Transitions
modules.tagline: Move to the part that matters.
modules.description: Disabled by default. Enable this block for explicit bounded Cut, Montage and Downtime commands; important choices remain unresolved.

modules.name: Continuous Scenes
modules.description: Reply boundaries require no chapter closure or posed wait. Independent actions may continue; actual player decisions remain yours.

modules.name: The Environment
modules.description: Background activity follows fictional time, motives, means and access. A schedule can mature without the avatar witnessing it.

modules.name: Narrator Lens
modules.description: The Observer and the other persona-style lenses bias emphasis without rewriting canon or personality.

controls.name: narrator_lens
controls.label: Narrator Lens
controls.description: Choose EiDOS’s narrative disposition: what she notices and which plausible opportunities she favors. This does not change character personalities or guarantee outcomes.

modules.name: Response Length
modules.description: Choose Targeted, Free-Flow or Pulse in one dropdown. Scene Word Aim applies in Targeted; Chapter Writing has its own aim.

controls.name: narrative_mass_mode
controls.label: Length Mode
controls.description: Targeted uses the scene word aim. Free-Flow selects length from the scene. Pulse uses a bounded contribution without a numeric target. Choose exactly one; Matrix keeps its separate chapter length.

controls.name: words_target
controls.label: Scene Word Aim
controls.description: Final-scene word aim in Targeted mode. Usual range ±15%; upper bound is the ceiling. Includes dialogue/thought text; excludes trace and Dock. Dormant in Free-Flow, Pulse, and Matrix.

modules.name: Point of View
modules.description: Narration perspective does not change ownership or grant access to the player’s interior.

controls.name: camera_lens
controls.label: Narration Perspective
controls.description: Select first-, second-, or third-person narrative perspective.

modules.name: Response Language
modules.tagline: Keep every voice in your language.
modules.description: Response Language applies to scene, commentary, cognition, menus and Archive values. Exact parser keys and static skin labels stay unchanged.

controls.name: response_language
controls.label: Response Language
controls.description: Language for the story, commentary, planning and Archive values: e.g. English, Español, Português, 日本語. Exact formatting keys stay stable; explicit OOC directions take priority.

modules.name: Prose Style
modules.description: The Style Kernel guides connected paragraphs, precise detail, distinct speech, viewpoint and meaningful interiority.

controls.name: prose_voice
controls.label: Prose Voice
controls.description: EiDOS literary framing or character-colored narration. Independent of POV, cognition route, and paragraph structure.

modules.name: Anti-Slop Filter
modules.description: The Cliché Gate targets canned constructions and semantic repetition alongside constructive prose guidance. Active by default; disable this block to opt out.

modules.name: Pronouns & Gender
modules.description: Follow the persona or choose a pronoun/gender override; current explicit OOC corrections take precedence.

controls.name: operator_identity
controls.label: Persona Identity
controls.description: Optional fictional-persona pronouns/gender grounding. One selection prevents conflicting toggles; Follow persona is the default. A newer explicit OOC correction takes precedence. They/them preserves stated gender.

modules.name: Character Resistance
modules.tagline: Affection does not erase a spine.
modules.description: Character Resistance changes willingness, never established facts or personality.

controls.name: contestant_friction
controls.label: Character Resistance
controls.description: Controls how readily characters yield while preserving their established personality.

modules.name: Emotional Consistency
modules.description: Preserve personality and mixed motives through closeness without compulsory softening or hostility.

modules.name: Belief & Evidence
modules.description: Separate evidence, explanations, private assessment, disclosure and cooperation. Expertise grants no hidden knowledge.

modules.name: Independent Lives
modules.description: People retain compatible routines, obligations and relationships outside the current exchange.

modules.name: Antagonist Behavior
modules.description: Optional antagonist profiles specify targets, methods, reach and restraints.

controls.name: antagonist_targets
controls.label: Antagonist Targets
controls.description: Exact character/faction names. Blank preserves Integrity only; no profile is applied to the whole cast.

controls.name: antagonist_method
controls.label: Antagonist Method
controls.description: Applies only to named targets, subordinate to established characterization.

controls.name: antagonist_reach
controls.label: Antagonist Reach
controls.description: A ceiling, never new powers, allies or access.

controls.name: antagonist_restraints
controls.label: Limits & Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Optional limits/commitments to apply to named antagonists; no retroactive erasure of canon.

modules.name: Favor Your Character
modules.description: Favor Your Character is off in the neutral release. It does not transfer control of your avatar.

modules.name: Attraction Bias
modules.description: Attraction Bias is off in the neutral release; ordinary chemistry still follows character and scene.

modules.name: Fork Protocol
modules.description: Choice Menus supplies five feasible RP actions or six Chapter Writing directions. Off suppresses both; hints grant no additional action.

controls.name: cyoa_enabled
controls.label: Choice Menus
controls.description: On: five Fork actions in roleplay, or six chapter directions in Matrix. Off: neither menu nor a plain-text substitute. Field Rules suppresses Fork. Disabling this block also leaves menus off.

modules.name: Conductance
modules.tagline: Track a bond, not a verdict.
modules.description: Conductance measures the main character’s stance with Affinity, Sparks and Grudge. Group modes can suspend it; it never reads your feelings.

controls.name: affinity_multiplier
controls.label: Affinity Change Limit
controls.description: Maximum per-turn Affinity shift; Sparks and Grudge remain momentum counters.

modules.name: Deep Archive
modules.description: Deep Archive maintains a complete current snapshot in available chat history, not an external or unlimited memory database.

modules.name: Relationship Map
modules.description: Relationship Map separates ensemble attachment, friction, leverage and changes.

modules.name: Unresolved Threads
modules.description: Unresolved Threads retains causal carriers, locks, age and weight; a loose end is not an automatic revelation.

modules.name: EiDOS Core Trace
modules.description: Optional short noncanonical core commentary. Both protected Black Veil modes suppress it.

modules.name: Kazz Parasite Feed
modules.description: An independent commentary voice, enabled in the official release. Choosing Kazz Override neither enables nor replaces his feed.

modules.name: Presentation
modules.description: Voice Effects, Dialogue Cards, Scene Motifs & Thoughts and Chapter Headers share this variable menu. The official switches start off.

controls.name: kinetic_vocal_tissue
controls.label: Voice Effects
controls.description: Opt-in, brief tremor/impact/quiet styling for dialogue and sounds. Separate from speaker colors and scene illustrations.

controls.name: dialogue_frames
controls.label: Dialogue Cards
controls.description: Separate present spoken dialogue into EiDOS panels. Coexists with speaker colors and Kinetic effects; does not style every quoted string.

controls.name: mnemonic_scenography
controls.label: Scene Motifs & Thoughts
controls.description: Optional authored object/weather motifs plus thought panels. Selects a fixed visual library instead of generating SVG geometry. Unsupported subjects remain prose.

controls.name: light_novel
controls.label: Chapter Headers
controls.description: EiDOS chapter/title/location/focus headers, stable chapter arcs, and optional meaningful scene breaks. Does not change narrative length or force genre tropes.

modules.name: Dialogue Cards
modules.tagline: Let each voice leave a signature.
modules.description: Tagged dialogue uses speaker labels, restrained effects and pastel-to-speaker color gradients. Enable through Presentation.

modules.name: Persona Status
modules.tagline: A readable inventory of the present.
modules.description: Persona Status is an optional established condition/equipment panel; it does not invent possessions.

modules.name: Cognition Settings
modules.description: Creative, Reconstruction and Kazz remain distinct routes. Full Creative/Kazz use the adjustable 1450-word aim; Light and Chapter Writing use compact records. Character Neurology is fixed; Agreement Bias Check is optional.

controls.name: cognition_route
controls.label: Cognition Route
controls.description: Choose Creative Pathfinding, EiDOS Reconstruction, or Kazz Override. Keep all three trace carrier blocks enabled.

controls.name: appeasement_interdict
controls.label: Agreement Bias Check
controls.description: Opt-in counterbias check for all three cognition routes. Challenges unearned agreement, surrender, forgiveness, and softening while preserving temperament and earned change. Recommended when a model shows positive/agreeability bias, including GLM and Claude models.

controls.name: cognition_effort
controls.label: Visible Trace Detail
controls.description: Controls the preset-authored visible plan, not native/provider reasoning. Off omits it; Light uses a compact card. Full Creative/Kazz always use Cognition Trace Word Aim. Reconstruction retains its existing ceilings; Matrix uses an author summary.

controls.name: cognition_word_aim
controls.label: Trace Word Aim
controls.description: Required numeric aim for full Creative/Kazz visible decision records. Default 1450 gives a 1400–1500 band; stage aims scale with it. Excludes story and Dock. Light, Off, Matrix, and Reconstruction keep their existing budgets; native reasoning is unchanged.
